title: Fallout 271 Return
description: A woman in a long red coat stands in a derelict, post-apocalyptic room filled with peeling posters and radiation symbols, holding a film reel as strips of film unspool across the cracked floor toward a massive opening revealing a desolate desert wasteland at sunset with a ferris wheel in the distance. Beams of light shine down from a broken ceiling onto a glowing gumball machine and scattered film strips.
prompt: A solitary woman wearing a long crimson coat stands inside a decaying room with torn movie posters and radiation hazard symbols on the walls, holding a film canister as film strips spill across the broken tile floor leading out into a vast ruined desert landscape at sunset featuring a distant ferris wheel and road signs, dramatic god rays streaming through a collapsed ceiling onto a glowing gumball machine spilling green orbs, cinematic composition, moody atmosphere
